svg.title: Harness before model
svg.desc: A hashed contract governs every card, a model that reads its outcomes is rejected, and the test set opens once. Steps: 1. Every experiment runs under a pre-registered contract. 2. The contract hash is stamped on every card. 3. A model that reads its own outcomes is rejected. 4. The held-out test set opens once per contract. Sources: The Readiness Loop README.

text.tspan: Every experiment runs under a pre-registered contract.
The contract hash is stamped on every card.
A model that reads its own outcomes is rejected.
The held-out test set opens once per contract.
A hashed contract governs every card, a model that reads its outcomes is rejected, and the test set opens once.
